Maria misses her family a great deal, especially given she hasn’t seen/visited them for the past 2 years since she has been at the US, with her only having brief phone calls with them over the past 2 years, with her fearing her family’s threats to disown her if she defies their wishes for her to marry Miguel. Maria feels too anxious/low self-confidence to defy her family’s wishes for her to marry Miguel, with her much preferring the safer route of just obeying her family’s wishes to make them happy, with her terrified of the idea that defying them could lead to her unable to see her beloved brother Juan and sister Rosa.
